name: @capri/desktop

scripts.test:voice: tsc src/renderer/audio/segmenter.ts src/renderer/audio/preroll.ts --outDir ../../.live/voice-segmenter --module commonjs --target es2022 --skipLibCheck && node scripts/voice-segmenter-check.cjs ../../.live/voice-segmenter
